comments.quote: The location is a bit out of the way, but the room was very clean with large floor-to-ceiling windows. The pool was also spotless, and the owner's cooking was fantastic. What's more, the owner was incredibly enthusiastic about recommending travel...
comments.author: Dagoushenger

comments.quote: Such a wonderful stay! The staff were so friendly and warm, the room was very clean, the swimming pool was very enjoyable, and there were lots of good restaurants nearby. They are also very pet friendly. Will definitely go there...
comments.author: KaylaA

comments.quote: The owner and his family are so friendly. 100% recommend
